name: Seven-Point
description: A seven-beat structure that moves from the hook to the resolution through two turns and two pinches.

beats.title: Hook
beats.note: Start with the character in a state that the story will change.

beats.title: Plot Turn 1
beats.note: Introduce the event that sends the character toward the main conflict.

beats.title: Pinch 1
beats.note: Apply pressure that shows the strength of the opposing force.

beats.title: Midpoint
beats.note: Shift the character from reacting to acting on the conflict.

beats.title: Pinch 2
beats.note: Apply a second, heavier pressure that seems to leave no way out.

beats.title: Plot Turn 2
beats.note: Give the character the last piece needed to resolve the conflict.

beats.title: Resolution
beats.note: Show the final outcome and the state the character ends in.
